brief: Fewer, better things - leather totes, cashmere wraps, capsule wardrobe pieces. Orders $200-400. We want affluent women who've outgrown fast fashion.

profile.business_summary: A premium DTC fashion brand offering high-quality capsule wardrobe pieces, leather totes, and cashmere wraps, targeting affluent women seeking sustainable, slow-fashion alternatives to fast fashion.
profile.product: Leather totes, cashmere wraps, and capsule wardrobe apparel
stated_claims: High-quality leather totes, cashmere wraps, and capsule wardrobe pieces
Designed for affluent women who have outgrown fast fashion

relevant_tags.why: Core product offering includes capsule wardrobe pieces and cashmere wraps.
Positioned as an alternative for consumers who have outgrown fast fashion, implying a slow-fashion, sustainable approach.
The 'fewer, better things' philosophy and capsule wardrobe pieces align with timeless, classic style.
Capsule wardrobe pieces and high-end totes heavily overlap with professional workwear needs for affluent women.

persona_conflicts.evidence: Targeting affluent women with high-ticket items ($200-400 orders).
